name: npc-click-quest-fallthrough
summary: An NPC whose applicable quest script is EMPTY ignores every click. Fall through to the NPC's own role (menu / shop / flavour text) when the quest click ran nothing.
status: PROVEN on a live zone 2026-09-17 with a scripted client (Fiesta2026on2016 tools/shim_client_test.py --click-mob). Same character, same quest row (20143 at status 6, DOING and END both empty), same click on Healer Ellen: stock sends nothing, patched sends 0x201C {2E 28}. Regression clicks on three NPCs with real quest scripts still draw their 0x4401 page. No crash file. The FIRST build of this recipe crashed the zone - read the cave notes.
why: ShinePlayer::InteractWithNPC (0x4C4660) decides what a click does BEFORE running anything:
r = CQuestZone::QuestPlayer_NPCClickCheck(npc)        ; 0x5BA250
r == 1  ->  QuestPlayer_NPCClick(npc)                  ; 0x5C0250 - RETURN VALUE DISCARDED
r == 2  ->  nothing (that quest's script is already running with this NPC)
r == 0  ->  the NPC's role: send 0x201C NPCMENUOPEN if NPCMenu, else call the role directly
NPCClickCheck answers 1 for any quest GetQuestStatusWithNPC picks whose status is 4..8 or 20. It never
looks at the script. NPCClick then runs QuestScriptRun, which picks START (4, 5, 20), DOING (6, 7) or END
(8), and each of those begins with CQuestParserScript::ParserStart -> CToken::OpenFromMemory, which
returns 0 for a zero-length script. So for an empty script the whole chain returns 0 - correctly
reporting that nothing ran - and InteractWithNPC throws that answer away. The server sends nothing and
the NPC is dead to that player for as long as the quest sits in that state.
Empty scripts are ordinary data, not a conversion artefact: the 2016 originals have 245 empty DOING and
83 empty END scripts, the 2026 set 262 and 91. It was found on Healer Ellen and the Mysterious Merchant
(TevaL), both merchants, both silent while a quest of theirs sat at status 6 on an empty DOING. That
particular trigger was a converter bug (fixed in Fiesta2026on2016 bc6cc39), but the mechanism is stock
2016 and any merchant, storage keeper or gate with such a quest goes the same way.
THE PATCH: the call at 0x4C48B3 goes through a 24-byte cave instead.
cave:  push dword [esp+4]      ; the NPC id AGAIN - see below
call QuestPlayer_NPCClick
test eax, eax
jz   fall
ret  4                  ; something ran (1) or is running (2): back to 0x4C48B8, arg popped
fall:  add  esp, 8             ; drop the cave's return address and the original argument
jmp  0x4C4805           ; the r == 0 path: the NPC's own role
THE ARGUMENT HAS TO BE PUSHED AGAIN. QuestPlayer_NPCClick is __thiscall with one stack argument and
cleans it with `ret 4`. Reaching it through a `call` from the cave puts a second return address on the
stack, so a bare `call` makes the callee read 0x4C48B8 as its NPC id. The first build of this recipe
did exactly that: GetQuestStatusWithNPC found no quest for NPC 0x48B8, and NPCClick - which assumes
NPCClickCheck already vouched for one - dereferenced the null at 0x5C0378. One click took zone 4 down
(2026-09-17 11:45:56, callstack 005C0378 <- 1BECA005 <- 004C4D5F). ecx, the `this`, survives a push.
0x4C4805 is where InteractWithNPC goes when NPCClickCheck says 0, reached from the same point as the
call site with the same stack depth (both follow NPCClickCheck's `ret 4`). It reads esi (the player) and
ebx (pushed for the role call); QuestPlayer_NPCClick saves and restores ebx, esi and edi, so they are
intact. The only state the failed quest click leaves behind is the session's current NPC (+0x904), which
the role path does not read, and current quest = 0xFFFF, which is its idle value.
A 0 from NPCClick can also mean a script that fails to PARSE. Falling through to the role is right for
that too - it is what the player would get from that NPC with no quest at all.
HOW TO PROVE IT: give a character a quest at status 6 whose DOING script is empty and whose NPC has
NPCMenu 1 (tools/quest_wipe.py in Fiesta2026on2016 restores a saved row), click the NPC, and look for
S->C 0x201C {mob id}. Stock: no reply at all. Patched: the menu opens.
